FAQ_Website_Q1: Waɗanne fasahohi ne ke tafiyar da wannan rukunin yanar gizon?
FAQ_Website_A1: An gina wannan rukunin yanar gizon ta amfani da Next.js (App Router), Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, da TypeScript.
FAQ_Website_Q2: Menene wahayi a bayan wannan rukunin yanar gizon?
FAQ_Website_A2: Shugaban STEI-K 2025 ne ya zaburar da samar da wannan rukunin yanar gizon.
FAQ_Website_Q3: Yaya ake inganta aikin wannan rukunin yanar gizon?
FAQ_Website_A3: An inganta rukunin yanar gizon don babban aiki, cimma kusan cikakkiyar Core Web Vitals da ingantaccen SEO.
FAQ_Website_Q4: Shin wannan rukunin yanar gizon yana samuwa ga masu sauraro na duniya?
FAQ_Website_A4: Ee, yana goyan bayan harsuna fiye da 12 don tabbatar da samun dama ga masu sauraro na duniya.
FAQ_Website_Q5: Yaya ake sarrafa sirrin mai amfani a wannan rukunin yanar gizon?
FAQ_Website_A5: Rukunin yanar gizon yana girmama sirrin mai amfani tare da sifili mai sa ido ko tattara bayanai.
Framework_Desc: An gina shi da Next.js 15, ta amfani da sabon App Router, React Server Components (RSC), da Turbopack don yin aiki cikin sauri.
Styling_Desc: Salo na musamman ta amfani da Vanilla CSS da Tailwind CSS, tare da mai da hankali kan kyawu na musamman tare da tallafin jigogi da yawa (Modern, Cinematic, Editorial).
Database_Desc: Gudanar da bayanan uwar garken ta amfani da Drizzle ORM tare da PostgreSQL da aka shirya akan Supabase, tabbatar da amincin bayanai da haɓaka.
Localization_Desc: Cikakken tallafin i18n don harsuna 18+, tabbatar da sauƙin shiga da ƙwarewa mara kyau ga masu sauraro na duniya.
Holistic_Approach_Desc: Hanyar injiniyan software gaba ɗaya wacce ta haɗa da ka'idodin yanar gizo na zamani, amincin nau'in TypeScript (TypeScript), da ƙira mai amfani da aiki.
Performance_Score_Desc: Samun maki 92 don Ayyuka, da 100 cikakke don Samun dama, Kyawawan Ayyuka, da SEO. Tabbatacce ta hanyar DebugBear.
